==English==

===Etymology===
Variant of {{der|en|fr|Paiement}}. This surname is mostly found in [[Canada]].

===Proper noun===
{{en-proper noun|s}}

# {{surname|en|from=French}}.

====Statistics====
* According to the 2010 United States Census, ''Payment'' is the 34314<sup>th</sup> most common surname in the United States, belonging to 661 individuals. ''Payment'' is most common among White (78.97%) and American Indian/Alaska Native (11.8%) individuals.
